body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Lenovo will unveil the first laptop supporting two LCD screens, 'ThinkPad W700ds' at the upcoming CES 2009. It has a 17-inch primary and a 10.2-inch secondary LED screen.

Coming with the option of either Intel Core 2 Extreme or Core 2 Quad processor, the ThinkPad W700ds adopts a 8GB of RAM, 980GB HDD and Nvidia Quadro FX 3700M. It also offers about 2 hours of battery life.
